newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bersani welcomes inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bersani welcomes inflation data.

text.p: Italian Industry Minister Pier Luigi Bersani said preliminary CPI inflation figures released on Monday would help the government sustain economic recovery.

"The first figures for the month of July confirm the positive trend on inflation and suggest unequivocably that the increase with respect to July last year is simply technical," he said in a statement.
"Today's data will help us work in the next few months to boost an already strong recovery without jeopardising the stability already acheived," he said.
Five Italian cities released CPI data for July on Monday. A further six cities were due to follow suit on Tuesday.
In the light of Monday's figures, analysts forecast July year-on-year CPI inflation at 1.5/1.6 percent and -0.1/0.0 month-on-month.
Final July figures will be released on August 5.
